reviews.title: Re-download, Re-install, every week or two
reviews.text:
If you’re expecting to receive thumbnails in your notifications (a bare minimum for “security” cameras imo), expect to have to fully delete and reinstall this app every week or two. 
Not a single other solution fixes the app’s issues (sign out and back in, restarting devices, restarting network, etc.). 

This has been an ongoing problem since they decided to add Anker to the name of the app and started ruining the app. 

After weeks of back and forth emailing them about this issue (while the world complained about the same thing on Reddit, etc.), but they provided no useful information with absolutely no sense of urgency and all they did
 was victim blame, as usual.
After a while, I finally decided to fully wipe the app from my phone and re-download it… fixed it for 12 days, but then as soon as my phone updated to 6.1.31 yesterday, my notification thumbnails dropped out again.. until this morning, after I, once again, deleted the app from my phone and reinstalled it. 

My record over the past couple of months has been 12 days (11.3-11.15).  

Prior to that, I’ve been lucky to get them working for even 5 days straight. 


However, prior to them adding the Anker name to this app and changing the logo, etc. (August/September 2026), the notification thumbnails worked 98% of the time for however many years I’ve had my homebase. 


Odd that they decided to finally add the Anker name to the eufy app, just in time for eufy to globally ruin Anker’s brand image.

reviews.title: Good Idea camera, bad app
reviews.text:
The concept of having a second, downward-facing camera specifically for monitoring packages is great. Unfortunately, the Eufy app falls short compared to competitors like Ring, particularly when it comes to motion detection, notification speed, and overall reliability.

Ring consistently delivers notifications faster and with less delay, while also reliably including a thumbnail preview. With Eufy, thumbnail notifications are inconsistent. Sometimes you get an image preview, while other times it’s just a text notification, which is frustrating.

Another issue is how notifications are handled. Sometimes I’ll receive a notification with a thumbnail, but tapping it takes me straight to the live view instead of the recorded event. Even worse, the recording isn’t always available in the Events tab immediately afterward, almost as if it hasn’t finished processing or saving.

Viewing recorded events is another frustration. Recordings are noticeably slow to load, seemingly due to the time it takes the app to decrypt the footage. This makes reviewing motion events unnecessarily tedious, especially when you’re trying to quickly see what triggered a notification.

The hardware and dual-camera concept are promising, but the app experience needs significant improvement. Fast, reliable notifications and quick access to recorded events are basic expectations for a security camera, and Eufy simply isn’t delivering the same level of consistency as Ring.

reviews.title: Step backwards from the old app
reviews.text:
It is buggy, inconsistent, and somehow less reliable than the app it is supposed to replace. Live updates showing device status and progress work when they feel like it. Sometimes they update correctly, sometimes they lag behind, and sometimes they seem completely disconnected from what the device is actually doing.

Even worse, the app will randomly act like devices I have already set up are brand new and try to walk me through setup again. That is not a minor inconvenience. That is basic device management functionality failing.

The most frustrating part is that the old app still works fine. So somehow Eufy managed to replace a functioning app with a worse one, then keeps pushing users toward the new experience anyway.

And then I look at all the glowing 5 star reviews and genuinely feel like the world has lost its mind. Are we all using the same app? Has everyone just collectively decided that broken, buggy, and less functional is good now? I feel like I am living in some bizarre alternate reality where companies make things worse and everyone applauds.

If you are going to force customers onto a replacement app, the replacement should at least be as stable and reliable as the one you are replacing. Right now it is not even close.

The old app works. The new app does not. Yet somehow the new one is the future.

reviews.title: It’s Gimmicky…
reviews.text: If I could give 0 stars I would. I have 7 Eufy products, and 3 different kinds of video recording devices from them. In all of them, you can’t scrub the footage natively in the app. Meaning if you’re watching a recording that’s say, 40 seconds long and 20 seconds in you want to go back to the 15 second mark to view something, you can’t. You can only play and pause the video. You cannot rewind or fast forward; jump back or skip forward. So you’d have to close the recording, then reopen it to replay it from the beginning 🙄 and then try to pause it at the 15 second mark that you’re trying to view again. 🙄 Not only are you UNABLE to go back/ rewind a recording, but you are also UNABLE to jump ahead. Eufy, what is the point of having a video length bar, if we’re not allowed to utilize it?!?! To be able to replay parts we’ve watched to review something, or jump ahead in footage we would have to download the recordings which is unnecessary and time consuming, ESPECIALLY when we’ve spent money buying a HomeBase 3 AND external storage in the home base. 🙄 Eufy PLEASE FIX THIS! This is kind of ridiculous and you’re making me consider reinstalling my Ring doorbell. This is a BASIC feature that all your competitors have natively in their apps.

reviews.title: Zero help technical support
reviews.text:
Somebody cut the power, we wanted to view the events to somebody cutting the power, once we rebooted the system, all previous events disappeared, the hard drive still says there’s 300 GB of used event data, that data cannot be review events disappear. The second you switched dates you see them for a split second and then they’re gone. Technical support was absolutely zero help. They recommend formatting the hard drive and are basically telling us to figure it out. why would I format a hard drive and erase the data I’m trying to review? I 1000% do not recommend the system to anybody. Use Google home cameras.

I’m making a Better Business Bureau FTC Federal trade commission complaint. Especially after they sent me instructions that included reformatting the hard drive. And that means erasing all the previous events that I know we’re still stored there.

Also, support is telling me that they’re going to send me a replacement device, even though my device is out of warranty, I sent them the receipt, when they told me this, they said they’re gonna send me a free device, even though my device is still under warranty because I have purchased it in less than a year ago, their manufacturer defect of warranty is a year, so they’re lying and trying to play the good guy, even though my device is still under warranty.

reviews.title: Great hardware, terrible app
reviews.text: I have the doorbell. Video quality is excellent. But the app leaves a lot to be desired. As others have mentioned, it’s so slow that delivery men have driven off by the time you get notified. But lately I have to log in to the app every time I want to view an event when I didn't have to before, slowing things down even more. Worse, whilst logged out I don’t get any notifications of events at all, so a parcel could be sitting on my doorstep for hours without me being alerted to it! So all I basically now have is a doorbell that rings through the separate chime but which is literally a waste of time when it comes to deliveries who don’t ring the bell or to viewing the camera.

reviews.title: Cumberson, clunky
reviews.text: I find the eufy application is increasingly difficult to use, with the obvious focus on Marketing rather than on quality user experience.  In the early days, this app was one of the best - it was friendly, easy to navigate, really quick and realy simple. One of its best features was that, if the doorbell rang, there were not a lot of steps to get to the camera view to see who is at the door.  (That IS, after all, why this app even exists, regardless what marketing might think!  And that IS why we spend our money...)  But over time it has devolved into a cumbersone app - especially with regard to the bloat-filled startup.  More times than not, I am greeted with a Login page, where I have to enter a password I don't remember (the app refuses to offer password saving after all these years).  Although I have Face ID set, this app (and none of my others) seems to have a problem with Face ID - it works about 50% of the time.  In the end, I usually spend about two minutes figuing out the password and getting logged in.  Once I'm logged in, I am greeted with an _old_ view from the camera (why?) and have to click on it for a live view. By the time all this has happened - the guest is either gone or as frustrated as me.  Useless!

reviews.title: No longer saves robot vacuum maps
reviews.text:
The app used to be excellent. It worked reliably, and I never had any issues with it. Unfortunately, over the past few months it has stopped saving any of the maps I create for my robot vacuum.

Every time I want to use it, I have to remap the entire house because, even after tapping “Save Map”, nothing is actually saved. This completely defeats the purpose of the mapping feature.

I stopped using the app for several months because I assumed an update would eventually fix the problem. However, I tried it again today and the issue still hasn’t been resolved. Having to remap the whole house every single time makes the app extremely frustrating and, for me, almost unusable.

reviews.title: Very disappointed from a such. a cool and progressive company
reviews.text:
How a company with such a good quality product can allow to have this mistakes on the app side of the business? This app has got worse every day since it was merged with the cleaning app. I can’t pair my Eufy RoboVac G30 Edge with my Wi-Fi, even though nothing has changed. My vacuum was working perfectly fine, but after resetting it and following the same pairing procedure I’ve used countless times before, it still won’t connect.

I’ve also gone through all of the troubleshooting guidance and tried every recommended step, but nothing has worked. It’s incredibly frustrating. Please bring back the developers who built the stable, less buggy version of this app, because the current team seems to be making things worse with every update.

I won’t comment on the camera side of the app, as that’s working fine for now, although I’ve had issues with it in the past.

Thank you!

reviews.title: Purchase at your and your family’s risk 🛑✋
reviews.text:
Rating: 1/5 Stars

Save your money. Save your sanity. And whatever you do, do not trust this lock with your family's safety.

I am the fool who bought this product twice. The first lock was a gift for my fiancée, a symbol of protection for the people I love most. Instead, it delivered nothing but frustration, sleepless nights, and hours of my life I will never get back. The fingerprint scanner? A complete failure from day one. It never worked. Not once.

After an exhausting back-and-forth with customer service countless emails that led absolutely nowhere they threw me a 30% discount as a peace offering. And like a desperate, hopeful idiot, I accepted. I convinced myself the "new and improved" version would be different. That this company had learned from its mistakes.

They hadn't. And neither had I.

This second lock suffers from the exact same fatal flaw. It refuses to connect to Wi-Fi no matter how many hours I wasted on the phone with T-Mobile, AT&T, EarthLink, believing I was the problem. Believing my internet was the weak link. But no. The weak link is this far from cheap, unreliable, janky excuse for a security device.

Do not make my mistake. Do not let a discount blind you to the truth. This company doesn't care about your safety they care about your wallet. They will sell you the same broken dream in a new box and call it an upgrade.

Save your money. Save your peace of mind. Buy literally anything else. And stay far, far away from this company.

reviews.title: Buggy and Slow
reviews.text: Generally find the app okay but app functionality with the SoloCam S4 app is bad. Trying to set Preset Positions is near impossible as the app doesn’t seem to be able to manage the split screens between the fixed and movable cameras. The aspect ratio of both images are compressed/flattened regardless of whether your device is in portrait or landscape orientation. And when then trying to set Activity Zones the app doesn’t always show the  Preset Positions you have managed to set. Seems to have got worse since moving from Homebase 3 to Homebase Professional S1. No matter how good the hardware is it is useless if the software is buggy or functionally doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Not what it once was
reviews.text: When i decided to make the switch from google nest to eufy, it seemed like best option. Especially because all the reviews I read and saw, always hyped it up and talked about how great the cameras and app were. I bought a whole set up about a year ago and even then I noticed everything was decent. But now it’s just frustrating to deal with. The cameras take forever to load, doorbell camera wont let me load up when someone is at the door so I can’t even see who is there. My security cameras also take a long time to load up. I don’t like how they don’t have live view from the grid. It’s really just a let down at this point. I got these cameras to be able to check on stuff on the fly and honestly it just takes too long. Customer service is great(had to replace a doorbell camera) they are quick to respond and i do like the company, but this camera side has not been my favorite at all.

reviews.title: Live feed not working!!!
reviews.text:
Live feed camera interface is no longer working. This is a major issue!

Previous behavior (correct):
- Go to the "Security" screen
- Tap on a camera
- The live feed starts as expected
Current behavior (bug)

- Tap on a camera
- Nothing happens (no UX feedback whatsoever)

This is an extremely blocking issue and has rendered my camera setup useless and potentially risks the security of my home. I really need to be able to check the live feed when I'm out of the house

reviews.title: Frustrating and extremely disappointing
reviews.text:
Considering how much money we’ve spent on these cameras, we expected them to work properly and for the app to be quick, reliable, and high functioning — especially given these are some of the most expensive cameras you sell. Unfortunately, that has not been our experience at all.
The system is constantly plagued by lag, delays, loading issues, crashes, glitches, and missing footage. Trying to review events is often incredibly frustrating, with repeated “no events for this day” messages even when footage should clearly exist.
The doorbell camera in particular misses huge chunks of important activity despite the settings being adjusted correctly. For example, I can leave the house, walk to the car, return to the house, and large parts — or sometimes all — of that activity are simply not captured.
More concerningly, something was recently stolen from a neighbour right outside the back of our house. The cameras had been recording and detecting people consistently throughout the entire day up until that exact period of time, yet for around an hour the system completely failed. No footage was available, no events were shown, and nothing was captured during the exact timeframe we actually needed the cameras to work. That is completely unacceptable for a security system at this price point.

reviews.title: Cumbersome needs desperate work!!
reviews.text:
The problem with eufy is they try to combine too much into one item and instead of having individual people working on individual sections they have a few people working on everything and you can clearly see where things will fall behind with that thought process. 

The eufy security section of this app is absolutely horrible. First they claim that there is an “AI”. It’s NOT an AI. It’s just an algorithm, looking for change in pixels and that’s it. How do I know this? because their “AI” cannot tell the difference between a flag and a human or even a PARKED car and a human. For the last 19 months, it has identified a car that it sits unused parked in a driveway, as a human. I’ve flagged it. I’ve reported it and nothing changes and it’s even worse when it rains. 
 
The functionality of this app is absolutely a beta and they clearly don’t have enough people assigned to it to fix any of the problems. They just rest on the fact that it exists, it’s semi functional and let’s just rake in money.  It’s absolutely pathetic as a security app. It’s so bad that I’ve had to turn off the alerts which completely undermines the purpose of having security camera.

reviews.title: Took away swipe back feature
reviews.text: Eufy has been getting hit or miss last few years.  Sometimes they will do an update that fixes things.  Most of the time it’s just to improve the NEW cameras NOT the old ones. I hate how they took away the swipe back in app feature by just swiping back.  Now you have to just hit the home buttons and it takes you back. Kinda intrusive to do when your 1 handed and can’t figure out why your cam is false triggering like crazy. Also takes a long time to load old recordings.  Sometimes they won’t even show up. Then you have to close the app multiple times and get back in, then it allows you to view old recordings.  Missing a lot of consistency. Eufy cams are meh anymore.  Cuz everyone’s spying on everyone now and eufy was called out for that a little while ago when they were able to view your thumbnails if they wanted.  So if your wife was walking naked thru the house, they could see it all.  I feel they should have went out to each customer and full disclosed that after they were caught.  Hard to trust them anymore… it’s going to take time and work on their end to win me over again….

reviews.title: Poor App
reviews.text:
Camera element of app is ok if not a bit laggy/slow, however cameras are reliable and app serves its purpose. 

Also use the app for the eufy L60 robot vac and it is awful. Used to have saved maps (one for each floor) in house. Now every time I open the app it has forgotten one or both the maps. When trying to add a second map it either doesn’t save or overnights the original map. Can also no longer see where the vac is or what it’s doing. 

Also the L60 vac is awful, it constantly needs the battery removing as it decides not to respond to the app and only way to connect again is by physically disconnecting and reconnecting the battery. Seems a common problem online with no recall on the product to rectify this.

reviews.title: Unusable notifications!
reviews.text: The thing that makes Eufy terrible is its dumb notification system. It’s SO bad that they take over your phone and you have to completely disable them.  We have three camera on the front of our property. As a result, someone walking in and out of the front door loading the car can generate 40+ notifications within 90 seconds. You can’t mute them, and it just peppers your phone with notifications meaning you can’t use your phone for anything else.  Solution - you have to completely disable notifications because the dumb software doesn’t let you set it to mute repeat notifications. Really dumb guys. So my advice is avoid Eufy until they one day improve their software. Many other issues but that’s the biggest one.

reviews.title: Devolved as an App
reviews.text: When I first downloaded this app ~2 years ago, it was good. Everything worked efficiently, loaded well, etc. At some point, that all changed. I think it came a few updates in when the notifications switched from “motion detected” to “someone has been spotted”. Odd verbiage. No big deal. Except for the fact that nothing really works now? In The Old Days, when I tapped on a notification it would take me straight to the recorded segment of whatever happened. Now it just takes you to the home screen, making you click to get to the recording section, only to find that the segment hasn’t populated yet. I got a notification today for movement, and it took another 20 minutes for that recording to populate in my activity page despite multiple new notifications. What? Why? You guys got it right two years ago-so what compelled you to change your perfectly functioning app? It also has a 50/50 chance of detecting a package. You know, the thing I bought it for. And if a package is placed further than a foot from the camera, every subsequent motion notification sends the ominous notification that “your package has been moved”, even if it’s just someone walking by, not having even glanced at my package. To the people developing this app, figure it out.

reviews.title: Not very good
reviews.text:
I’ve just upgraded to the new app after spending months getting my cleaner to the way I like. They have renamed the device, and called all of my tasks Robovac. They have altered all of the tasks so now have to go through everything and tell it what to do. On top of that I can’t see at a glance which is which because the name of the device is in block capitals and it obscures the task. They seem to think that the name Robovac on everything is more important than allowing customers to see what they want. All in all it’s dreadful, they could have at least respected what their customers have set up.

I see what went wrong. Your upgrade duplicated the device about six times, once for each task I had set up, I’ve now deleted them and renamed the device to my original name.

reviews.title: Good hardware, meh software
reviews.text: Eufy hardware seems capable, well-made, and reasonably priced. However, the product line fails to completely satisfy because the software is not completely useful. There is AI face recognition, which is a nod to the hype around AI, but they don’t seem to understand the use cases that a homeowner would value. I have a choice of getting notifications and recording about everything, or nothing. What I want is to not be informed when somebody walks by on the sidewalk, but I do want to be informed when somebody comes to the door. If I don’t have the “bother me about everything” mode enabled, I won’t even get an event, much less an image capture or recording, if somebody rings the doorbell. Just today the Eufy doorbell was rung; I could see that it was two men, but I was unable to answer the door. Later I had no record of that event. If a package is left on my front steps, Eufy won’t tell me about it unless I have the “bother me about everything” mode enabled. The visual scene for somebody walking by on the sidewalk is very different from the visual scene of somebody approaching my door. I would think that AI would be capable of classifying these events pretty well. I assume Eufy is a company of technologists, and not user experience people.

En na twee maanden worden ze blijkbaar spontaan verwijderd terwijl mijn opslag voor 90 % nog leeg is. En notificaties van bekende personen is in de app uit te zetten maar dat werkt totaal niet. reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text:
We’ve had the eufy doorbell system for years and it used to be good but it has gradually declined & since the latest update I’m now unable to view the live feed even when at home (I was experiencing this issue intermittently when away from home prior to the last update but it always worked when I was at home).
We have really good WiFi and everything else is working perfectly except the doorbell. 
Every time I open the live feed I get an error message that it cannot connect, I’ve tried restarting the router and the chime several times, occasionally when resetting the chime it will then bring up the live feed temporarily but 10mins later when we try to access it again the error message appears and we’re back to square one.

reviews.title: Good hardware, but very poor app experience
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with the Eufy app experience. The recent “UI update” looks almost identical to the old app and brings no real usability or performance improvements.

MAJOR issues remain unresolved:

• Doorbell charging bug - My Video Doorbell E340 shows a charging icon while wired, yet the battery percentage continues to drop day by day. After firmware resets and battery replacements, the app still reports charging incorrectly, making battery status unreliable.

• WiFi vs HomeBase 3 instability - My Floodlight Cam E340 supports direct WiFi connection as a multi bridge option, which provides a much faster and more reliable live view. However, almost every day the app automatically switches the camera back to HomeBase 3 instead of staying on the selected WiFi network. When this happens, live view becomes very slow, laggy, or takes a long time to load. I then have to manually go into Settings, General, WiFi Connection, configure WiFi, find my network, and reconnect again. This repeats frequently and wastes a lot of time. If the WiFi connection is stable and faster, the app should respect the user’s choice and stay connected to WiFi, not automatically revert to HomeBase 3. There is currently no option to lock, bind, or prioritise the selected network, which is very poor design.

reviews.title: Unusable!
reviews.text:
When I first purchased my Eufy Video Doorbell E340, the app worked perfectly. Unfortunately, since the version 5.0 update, performance has steadily declined, and each update seems to make things worse rather than better.

When someone rings my doorbell, I receive a notification, but opening the live view can take up to 60 seconds or more. By the time the video finally loads, the person at the door has usually already left. Recorded clips can now take up to five minutes to appear, which completely defeats the purpose of having a smart doorbell.

Since updating to version 5.6.00, the app has become even less reliable. I now receive no notifications at all when someone approaches or rings the doorbell. This issue affects all of my devices and started immediately after updating the app.

What is particularly frustrating is that the adverts within the app load instantly and work perfectly, with no delays whatsoever, while core features such as live view, recordings, and notifications are painfully slow or non-functional. It gives the impression that advertising is being prioritised over the customer experience.

I paid a significant amount of money for this system, and it is extremely disappointing to see its functionality degraded through software updates rather than improved.

reviews.title: Doorbell camera not quite good enough
reviews.text:
The doorbell camera takes way too long to register and when it enviably notifies you that there’s someone at the door, the person has either moved away (especially with delivery drivers) who haven’t got all day to wait for your camera to pick them up and for you to eventually respond!

Them images from the camera are ok but field of view and the time it takes for the camera to register images, notify you, then open the app and for you to eventually have a meaningful conversation with the person at the door requires huge improvement and is the main massive let down for all versions of Eufy doorbell cameras!

reviews.title: Software lets it down.
reviews.text: I like the cameras. Batteries don’t last as long as stated. The worst issues are related to functionality and the technical back up from Eufy. Eufy over the last 3 years have been unable on numerous occasions to assist with app functionality when called and tickets are raised. It’s a real shame as the people on the customer service desk and technical have one role and on the majority of occasions have not been able to assist. The most recent issue has been with dual sim incompatibility where on data I have to turn off1 of the sims to retrieve footage. That’s been ongoing for over a year with no fix insight. A more recent issue is with cross tracking that doesn’t allow the combined videos to be downloaded even though the process shows the operation as being successful.
